source.scope_caveat: Via-specific rules are distinct from component PTH annular-ring rules. This is not permission to change the frozen PCBWay stack or to apply via rules to castellations.

checks.original_copper_checks: Unchanged geometry inherits the separately reviewed 22031 copper/route checks; this script independently checks the stricter 0.20 mm hole-to-copper rules only.

conclusion: The 0.075 mm annulus fails the chosen PCBWay 3 mil criterion but is not a universal topology rejection: nominal 0.30/0.15 mm matches JLCPCB preferred diameter-increase guidance and this sparse witness passes its 0.20 mm hole-clearance screen.
